changelog: ✨ Streamlined Clean Phone UI: Instant access to content rows
🔥 Direct HLS Stream Engine: Restored high-speed multi-audio Hindi/English/South streams for all movies & series
⚡ Fixed OTA Update: Direct zero-redirect updater
🌐 DNS-Over-HTTPS Bypass: Integrated Google DoH resolver to defeat ISP-level DNS blocks on movie streaming hosts (Jio/Airtel/ACT).
📦 Android 5.0+ / Fire OS 5 Package Parse Fix: Lowered minSdkVersion to 21 with dual v1/v2 signatures to resolve 'Problem parsing the package'.
📺 Zero-Frame-Drop Live Broadcast Video: Custom MediaCodecVideoRenderer prevents ExoPlayer from discarding jittery live stream video frames.
⚡ 30 Mbps High-Speed Streaming: Bandwidth meter baseline, 16-connection keep-alive pool, and instant 500ms playback start.
🏷️ Clean Labels: Eliminated [object Object] under thumbnails with strict category string normalization.
